How can you Permanently ban someone? :: Insurgency Server Admin Support
How to ban/switch/kick people on own server? :: Insurgency Server Admin Support

notes: Insurgency (2014) is a Source SDK 2013 game, so this is plain Valve Source RCON carried on the game port over TCP: srcds must be launched with -usercon and a non-empty rcon_password must be set (insurgency/cfg/server.cfg). There is no separate RCON port - it follows -port, 27015 by default. info and listPlayers are both 'status' because Source has no dedicated player-list command; bot slots print BOT in place of a Steam ID in status output and are deliberately dropped by playerParse. kickid accepts either the numeric userid from status or the STEAM_ uniqueid; the Steam ID is recorded because userids are reassigned as players reconnect. banid's first argument is MINUTES with 0 meaning permanent, and the trailing literal 'kick' is what also removes the player immediately - banid on its own only adds the entry to the in-memory ban list. Neither banid nor removeid persists on its own: 'writeid' must be run to rewrite insurgency/cfg/banned_user.cfg, and server.cfg normally carries 'exec banned_user.cfg' to reload it at boot. No command sets the MOTD - it is the file insurgency/motd.txt - so motd is omitted. IP bans are a parallel set (addip/removeip/writeip, insurgency/cfg/banned_ip.cfg) and are not modelled here. Hosting-provider pages (Citadel Servers, Pingperfect, Streamline Servers) were checked and carry no usable command text, only rcon_password setup, so nothing here rests on them.
